notes: No complete queued-discharge window was available. Exit service time uses the mean of the fastest quarter of positive gaps between exit crossings. This is an assumed capacity proxy: it does not establish saturated exit capacity or show that a queue was observed, and crossings can include multiple lanes.
The departure-headway estimate (0.381s) is below the simulator's minimum service time; the model uses 1.0s per vehicle instead. This floor is a model assumption, not a measurement.
Free-flow time = median travel time of vehicles that never queued.

sample.title: Real traffic · Lysaker, Norway
sample.description: A public-road, free-flow traffic example processed with FLOWLAB's ordinary detector and tracker. It is not a Georgia school dismissal study.
sample.author: Kjetil_r
processing_notes: Source excerpt: 5-30 seconds, original timing retained. Background stabilization, edge cropping, resizing and audio removal; no generated vehicles or interpolated frames.
YOLO11n + ByteTrack; sampled at 10 fps. Precomputed results use the same pipeline as uploads. No manual detector-accuracy benchmark has been performed.
This is free-flow highway traffic with opposing directions. Entry/exit lines measure the near carriageway; the tracked-vehicle count covers the full scene.
Tracked counts are retained tracker IDs, not a manually verified count of unique physical vehicles; ID switches can split a vehicle into several tracks.
Perspective, residual camera drift, occlusions and fragmented tracks affect measurements. Image motion is not a calibrated physical speed.
